title: LiquidX v2 (LQDX) — Missing Access Control in `deposit` Function Analysis
root_cause: The `account` parameter in `deposit()` is not validated to equal `msg.sender`, allowing arbitrary use of tokens approved by third parties
steps: → [1] Confirm victim has approved 10 WETH to LiquidXv2Zap
→ [4] victim's 10 WETH → transferred to zap contract
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Confirm victim has approved 10 WETH to LiquidXv2Zap
  │
  ├─→ [2] Query pair reserves (WETH/LQDX pair)
  │
  ├─→ [3] Call deposit(
  │         account = victim,      ← specify victim address
  │         amounts = [victimBalance],
  │         swapBlocks = []
  │       )
  │
  ├─→ [4] victim's 10 WETH → transferred to zap contract
  │
  └─→ [5] Victim balance decreases, attacker profits
